# Knowledge Reconciliation
Current repository/production truth outranks memory, handovers and prior agent reports. Preserve provenance and freshness for decisions, incidents, regressions and debt. When evidence contradicts stored knowledge, record the contradiction, invalidate stale claims and propagate impact to dependent missions/certification. Do not use arbitrary confidence percentages as a substitute for evidence.
